scope: Strict private response contracts for nutrient balances, strategy plans, and competitive-landscape summaries.
Python 3.11/3.12-stable AST fingerprints for the runtime SQL unresolved-write inventory gate.

constraints: Strict nested response allowlist and request-bound location/page metadata.
Finite aggregate values and strict count types.
has_more is checked against totals and remains false when the 10,000 offset ceiling prevents continuation.
Strict schema-aligned plan projection with privacy-sensitive rationale, party identities, private amounts, and execution authority excluded.
Bounded pagination matches migration 452's 50-row page plus lookahead contract and 10,000 offset ceiling.
Strict aggregate-only response projection excludes private party, actor, position, evidence, signal, and outcome fields.

gateway_contracts.error_behavior: Existing authorization, input, cache, and sanitized database-error behavior is preserved; malformed service projections fail with sanitized no-store errors.

ci_inventory_repair.cause: Python 3.12 includes empty type_params=[] in AST dumps for functions and classes, changing fingerprints relative to Python 3.11.
ci_inventory_repair.fix: Normalize only empty type_params from a copied AST before fingerprinting; preserve non-empty generic type parameters.

checks.command: focused Gateway response-contract selection across irrigation, landscape, pollinator, nutrient, strategy, and competitive landscape
ruff check on all changed Python modules and tests
py_compile changed modules/tests on Python 3.11 and the inventory scanner/regression tests on Python 3.12

limitations: Route checks validate source/API projections; they do not establish populated-data parity, live OIDC behavior, or broader tenant isolation.
The Python 3.12 inventory gate and compilation passed; the pytest regression suite ran under Python 3.11 because pytest is unavailable in the Python 3.12 runtime.
